newsitem.title: UK: Alliance & Leicester expectations grow. [CORRECTED 16:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Alliance & Leicester expectations grow. [CORRECTED 16:00 GMT]

text.p: Expectations for the opening share price of Alliance & Leicester Plc were increasing on Friday ahead of an auction in which institutions will place bids for shares in the banking group.

Financial bookmaker IG Index said punters were betting that the shares would close their first day of trade next Monday above 528p. The "spread" of the bet stood at 520-528p by 1358 GMT, after an initial offering of 494-502p on Thursday.
IG said the volume of business had mostly been on the buy side. "We've simply moved the price with the flow of business, almost all bets have been buyers," the bookmaker said.
The first of a possible series of share auctions will take place between 1530 GMT and 1730 GMT on Friday.
The bidding will influence the price at which the shares open on the London Stock Exchange next Monday.
About 157 million shares in Alliance & Leicester will be on offer after members opted to sell almost 27 percent of their free allocation.
Analysts believe that some fund managers may pitch their bids as high as 520p a share to secure a stake of the offer.
Last October, Alliance's top estimate of the value of its shares was 435p. At 520p, members would find their 250 share allocation to be worth 1,320 stg.

Stockbroker Cazenove & Co will announce the result of the first auction of shares after the market opening on Monday. Bids will be accepted at varying prices down to a minimum clearing price. Even if demand is high, two further auctions will take place next week, Cazenove said.
"It's a chance for the institutions to put their money where their mouth is," commented one trader, speculating that the top bids would come in around 5.00 stg a share.
"The newspapers suggest all the shares will go in one auction, but not from the level of business we've been seeing," another said.
